description.en: The ID of the ECS instance from which to detach the file system.
The ID of the database file system.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region where the DBFS instance resides. You can call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，请注意：

- 数据库文件系统必须已经挂载到实例上，状态为已挂载（Attached)。

- 卸载数据库文件系统时，所挂载的ECS实例必须处于运行中（Running）或者已停止（Stopped）状态。

- DetachDbfs是异步操作，调用接口成功后等待一分钟左右才能完成卸载。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, note the following:

- The DBFS must be attached to an instance and in the Attached state.

- The ECS instance to which the DBFS is attached must be in the Running or Stopped state.

- DetachDbfs is an asynchronous operation. After you successfully call it, the file system takes about one minute to detach.
